events.title: Gear Up for Epam (EPAM) Q1 Earnings: Wall Street Estimates for Key Metrics
events.body: Looking beyond Wall Street's top-and-bottom-line estimate forecasts for Epam (EPAM), delve into some of its key metrics to gain a deeper insight into the company's potential performance for the quarter ended March 2026.

events.title: Unisys (UIS) Reports Q1 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
events.body: Unisys (UIS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +63.64% and +5.75%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Earnings Preview: What to Expect From EPAM Systems’ Report
events.body: EPAM Systems will release its first-quarter earnings next month, and analysts anticipate a double-digit bottom-line growth.
